adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly adds `Post.cook_methods` with `:raw_html` and changes `Post#cook` to `return raw if cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` (app/models/post.rb), which bypasses the normal cooking pipeline (`post_analyzer.cook`) where Discourse typically performs markdown processing and HTML sanitization. The new embedding/feed import path sets `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` when creating posts (app/models/topic_embed.rb via `PostCreator.new(... cook_method: ...)`), and the embed view renders `raw post.cooked` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb). For RSS polling, content is taken from the feed (`CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`) and imported without any sanitization step in this diff (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb + TopicEmbed.import), so this can introduce XSS/unsafe HTML rendering.
